To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the fraction conversion models are more suitable for describing the color changes of tea during hot-air drying and the computer vision system is a good tool to study color changes during drying.

the fraction conversion kinetic model was the best model in describing the color changes of tea during hot-air drying, the computer vision system was a suitable method for color analysis, and the color change of tea during drying depended on air temperature and air velocity.

the color parameters (L*, a*, b*, ΔE*, C* and H*) of green tea were changed during hot-air drying, and the best model for describing the color changes during hot-air thin-layer drying of green tea was the fractional conversion model.

the application of image processing and color analysis to the drying of green tea.
the color changes of the green tea during hot-air drying process and the effect of drying conditions.

the development of a computer vision system for the color changes of tea leaves during hot-air drying and the effect of air flow velocity and air temperature on kinetics of color parameters during drying.
